This policy explains what personal information we collect through wabisabiservices.ca and when you contact or book with us, why we collect it, who we share it with, and the choices you have. We follow British Columbia's Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA). What we collect Contact form: your name, email, phone number, address, service type, cadence, and any notes you add. Booking form: your name, email, phone number, address, service type, cadence, and preferred times. Careers form: your name, email, phone number, the position you're interested in, your experience, your availability, and your message. Seasonal checkout: your name, email, phone number, address, city, and postal code. At seasonal checkout, your billing address and card details are entered on Stripe's page, never on this site. When you become a client: your signed agreement, access details such as door codes, lockbox or key arrangements, pet and home notes, any before-and-after photos you permit, and a credit card kept on file for bookings. When you call or email us: your contact details and what you tell us. Automatically when you visit the site: pages viewed, links clicked, device and browser type, approximate location (city level), how you arrived (for example, a Google search), and cookie or similar identifiers. See "Analytics" below. How we use it To prepare estimates, schedule and deliver our services, and follow up about your service. To answer your questions and keep records of our work. To send service messages (confirmations, reminders, invoices). To review job applications. To understand how people use our website and improve it. Analytics We use the following tools on wabisabiservices.ca: Google Analytics measures how visitors use the site. Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights measure site usage and performance. Axiom stores page speed measurements in the United States. Each one holds how long the page took to load, the page address without any search details, the time, and whether the screen is phone-sized. They don't include your name, email, IP address or cookies. Microsoft Clarity records how visitors use our pages (clicks, scrolling and mouse movement) to produce heatmaps and session replays that help us improve the site. Text you type into forms is masked before it leaves your browser. Microsoft's privacy statement: privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement. Clarity uses first- and third-party cookies (such as _clck and _clsk) and similar technologies, and Microsoft may also use this data as described in its privacy statement, including for advertising. Apart from Axiom, these tools use cookies and similar technologies. You can: Opt out of Google Analytics with the browser add-on at tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout. Block or delete cookies in your browser settings. Who we share it with We don't sell your personal information. We share it with the service providers who help us run the business, including those listed below, and with partners we arrange for you. Stripe processes payments at seasonal checkout and keeps your order details, including your name, email, phone number and address. Google provides Analytics and web fonts. Vercel hosts the website, runs our forms and checkout, and measures site performance and usage. Resend delivers the emails our forms send. Microsoft provides Clarity (site-usage analytics). Partners we arrange for you, such as exterior window cleaners, receive the details needed to do that work. Some of these providers store information outside Canada, including in the United States, where it may be subject to local laws. We may also disclose information if the law requires it. How long we keep it We keep booking and billing records for six years from the end of the tax year they relate to, in line with Canada Revenue Agency record-keeping requirements. We keep other client details, including access details, only as long as we need them to serve you. We keep inquiries that don't lead to a booking, and job applications, for one year. How we protect it Access to client information is limited to the people who need it to do their jobs. We use reputable providers with security safeguards. No system is perfectly secure, so please contact us right away if you think your information has been misused. Your choices and rights You can ask to see the personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or withdraw your consent at any time. You can also ask us to delete information we no longer need. We'll respond within 30 days. If you're not satisfied with our response, you can contact the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner for British Columbia (oipc.bc.ca). Contact us Privacy questions or requests: Privacy Officer: Jalene Plamondon, Wabi Sabi Services Email: hello@wabisabiservices.ca Phone: (250) 896-5971 Changes to this policy We'll post any changes on this page and update the "Last updated" date. /areas/uplands.text: Wabi Sabi Services About Services Areas The Ritual Reviews Blog FAQ Careers Contact BOOK NOW Home Service Areas Uplands Bespoke Concierge Cleaning in Uplands Heritage-aware care for an Olmsted garden suburb of trophy estates. Uplands is the rarefied heart of Oak Bay's estate district — a 465-acre garden suburb laid out by landscape architect John Charles Olmsted in 1907 and designated a National Historic Site in 2019. We bring quiet, museum-level care to its serpentine roads and trophy estates, where discretion is not a luxury but a baseline expectation. REQUEST A PRIVATE CONSULTATION BOOK NOW Discreet, fully vetted, and insured care for Victoria's most discerning homes. Caring for Homes in Uplands Few addresses on Vancouver Island carry the prestige of Uplands. Olmsted's plan — gentle serpentine roads tracing the contours of the land, generous setbacks, and preserved Garry oak meadows — created a neighbourhood that still feels like a private park more than a subdivision. Homes here are among the most valuable in the region, and their owners expect a level of care that matches the address. The 1913 Riffington estate, designed by architect Philip A. Jullien in the Tudor Revival manner, is emblematic of the craftsmanship found throughout the enclave. Many residences are heritage-listed, which means routine cleaning here is never routine: surfaces, millwork, and finishes must be treated with an awareness of preservation guidelines and the building's original materials. Our concierge approach builds careful interior care for stone and marble into a tailored plan, so the home's value and character are protected season after season. Why Discerning Uplands Homeowners Choose Us Discreet, fully vetted staff suited to the privacy expectations of nationally significant estates. Heritage-preservation awareness woven into every clean, respecting designation guidelines. Ongoing interior care for stone and marble in homes facing the Strait.
